turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
at 9:05 AM

Hello, normally tracking is sent as soon as the parcel ships.

As a general guide, in-stock non-bulky items are usually shipped within 2 to 5 business days, while bulky items can take 2 to 4 weeks depending on availability. The estimated timing for each item is also shown on the product page, next to the Add to cart button.

You can also find tracking in your customer account under My orders, or in the shipping email once it has been sent.

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
AI agent, Today at 9:05 AM

Once your order has shipped, delivery time depends on the shipping method and the type of item.

For non-bulky items in France, home delivery is usually 2 to 5 business days with Colissimo, and 4 to 7 business days for relay point delivery with Colissimo or Mondial Relay. For larger items, delivery is generally arranged within 1 to 3 weeks after shipment.

The most precise estimate remains the one shown on the product page.
